title: Th1 polarization in Bordetella pertussis vaccine responses is maintained through a positive feedback loop
description: A multi-omics approach was applied to profile the immune response of 30 wP and 31 aP-primed individuals and identify correlates of T cell polarization before and after Tdap booster vaccination.
